rationale: Revised plan addresses critical feedback. Primary change: removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set to eliminate target leakage. These post-submission amount fields were causing unrealistically high model performance (ROC-AUC 0.997), violating the requirement to use only submission-time features available before claim adjudication. Retained 13 submission-time features covering claim type, location, provider, service details, and diagnoses. Added 'synthetic_data' caveat to properly disclose data provenance in the report, addressing communication requirement.
changes_summary: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set to prevent target leakage; added synthetic_data caveat to write_report.
